name: shopping-agent
description: Search Shopify Global Catalog and return verified product cards with fail-closed affiliate-ready links.

interface.shortDescription: Verified cards, pricing, coupons, and safe links.
interface.longDescription: FindCheap-Agent is a Codex Plugin Agent. v0.4.1 searches Shopify Global Catalog across eligible merchants, renders verified product cards, and supports checked-in approved affiliate relationships with credential-gated deep links and nearby disclosure. With no approved relationship configured, every CTA remains a canonical merchant link. Affiliate state never affects ranking. User-authorized Chrome is used only after complete zero-result API coverage.
defaultPrompt: Call search_shopify_products once with no preamble; then call render_product_cards once with renderId. Never launch MCP.
